dogecoin.text:
Act 1: "Blind Hype" (2021, Dogecoin)
The Scene: Doge soars to $0.70. Everyone trades the "Elon wave."

Fundamentals: Zero.
No dApps
90% of tokens held by top 10 wallets
Network fees: $0.001

The End: Crashed 90%. Those who didn’t exit lost everything.

Moral: Hype fades.

Chapter 1: The Meme Dream (2021)
🐶 Alex:
Went all-in on Dogecoin

Chased every viral trend

Portfolio 10x'd... then crashed 90%

📊 Sam:

Tracked Ethereum gas fees

Noticed stablecoin mint surges

Built positions around real usage
